Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

tidystata 0.4.1

  • Shorter, task-focused help, with editor and clipboard lookup guidance under findit().
  • Clearer README examples and frequency-table headings.

tidystata 0.4.0

  • Added corr(), spearman(), encode() and Stata-style stata_recode() (recode()). pwcorr() gains listwise deletion and p-value adjustments; Spearman p-values now use Stata 18’s beta approximation.
  • findit() accepts Stata text, improves matching and statistical examples, and adds editor/clipboard helpers. The bilingual reference uses smaller chapters.
  • Breaking changes: as_character() now aliases tostring(); use decode() for labels. pct() is removed; use pc(). Preview helpers become preview() and unpreview(), with head/tail and interval shortcuts; former names and row-slicing helpers are removed without aliases.
  • isid() replaces .missok with .missing and rejects empty strings by default. capture() returns the result or invisible NULL, replacing Booleans.
  • Added label-based dummy names and .type = "tibble" for ds(), summ() and tabstat(). Summary annotations now use messages.
  • Faster, leaner calculations; fixes for weights, missing values, conversions, binning, dummy variables and input validation. Clearer help and previews.

tidystata 0.3.2

  • Fixed weighted summaries, percentile overflow and grouping/weight-column selection in summaries, tabulations and correlations.
  • stata_merge() preserves master keys and matched values, retaining shared values on using-only rows.
  • Binning handles SPSS missing values and rejects integer64; row extrema handle one-row groups and missing constants correctly.
  • tostring() avoids scientific notation; destring() handles labelled text and rejects doubled signs. misstable() counts SPSS missing values.
  • Fixed assertion collisions, factor ordering, Cramer’s V, empty dummy inputs, selection validation and other edge cases.

tidystata 0.3.1

  • Added a searchable bilingual Stata-to-R reference with source-linked examples, alternative approaches and command/package indexes.
  • findit() improves statistical mappings, missing-value handling, abbreviations and query matching. Variable names and hints customize examples; compact defaults retain expandable alternatives, qualifications and sources.

tidystata 0.3.0

  • Renamed statart to tidystata, focusing on exploration and preparation; removed legacy import/export, regression and plotting wrappers.
  • Added findit() for Stata commands, R functions and plain-language questions, with bilingual guides and compact, coloured examples.
  • Expanded tabulations, weighted summaries, correlations, missing-value reports and grouped calculations.
  • Added key checks, duplicate handling, Stata-style merges, panel operators, transformations and persistent previews.
  • Checked statistical conventions against Stata; preserved table containers and consistent missing-value and label handling.
  • Faster row calculations and aggregation, with fewer dependencies. Requires R 4.1.0 and dplyr 1.1.4 or later; flextable is optional.

tidystata 0.2.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.
